Messages.Author: Dasein
Messages.Body:
Just say I have a vampire with superior Auspex, superior Fortitude,
and a Sabbat Priest political card on him. He performs a bleed action,
and one of my prey's (younger) vampires attempts to block.
I have a Crocodile's Tongue and a Kiss of Ra in my hand.
What order to 'attempts to block' effects happen in? How wide is the
window to play them, i.e. can I play multiple cards one after another,
each resolving separately, or do I have to play all 'when a minion
attempts to block' at the same time that the block attempt happens?

In my example, I'm guessing that first of all the blocking minion
burns a blood from the Sabbat Priest card, because it's already in
play. Then I can play the Crocodile Tongue; the minion still wants to
block so burns two blood to cancel the card. Can I then play Kiss of
Ra to burn another two blood off him and send him to torpor? Or do I
have to play the Croc Tongue and the Kiss of Ra together? In that
case, the vampire would obviously choose not to cancel the Croc Tongue
since he's going to torpor from the Kiss anyway.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Dasein wrote:

> Just say I have a vampire with superior Auspex, superior Fortitude,
> and a Sabbat Priest political card on him. He performs a bleed action,
> and one of my prey's (younger) vampires attempts to block.

.. burning one blood for the Priest.

> I have a Crocodile's Tongue and a Kiss of Ra in my hand.
> What order to 'attempts to block' effects happen in? How wide is the
> window to play them, i.e. can I play multiple cards one after another,
> each resolving separately, or do I have to play all 'when a minion
> attempts to block' at the same time that the block attempt happens?

You may play Crocodile's Tongue. If the blocking minion doesn't
burn the blood, then the block would be canceled, and you'd have
to wait for another minion (controlled by another Methuselah in this
case, by card text on CT) to attempt to block before you could play
Kiss of Ra. If he burns the blood to continue blocking, then you
could play Kiss of Ra.

You may plya Kiss of Ra first, but then the action would be ended and
you wouldn't be able to play Crocodile's Tongue.

> In my example, I'm guessing that first of all the blocking minion
> burns a blood from the Sabbat Priest card, because it's already in
> play. Then I can play the Crocodile Tongue; the minion still wants to
> block so burns two blood to cancel the card. Can I then play Kiss of
> Ra to burn another two blood off him and send him to torpor? Or do I

Yes.

> have to play the Croc Tongue and the Kiss of Ra together? In that

No cards are played together unless card text says so (Concealed
Weapon and a weapon, for example), and even then the first one
must resolve in order to "pull play" the second one.

> case, the vampire would obviously choose not to cancel the Croc Tongue
> since he's going to torpor from the Kiss anyway.
